title: Mo'CharmsMod
description: Mo'CharmsMod is a Minecraft mod that adds powerful, clickable charm items that grant temporary potion effects, letting players activate special abilities on demand for strategic gameplay.
body:
**Mo'CharmsMod adds a collection of powerful charm items that grant temporary potion effects to enhance your gameplay experience. Each charm provides a unique ability designed for strategic use in survival worlds. ✨🧿**

Charm effects can be triggered on click while holding the charm item, allowing players to activate abilities instantly whenever needed ⚡ This makes them perfect for combat ⚔️, exploration 🧭, or emergencies 🚨.

**Each charm grants a timed effect, giving players enhanced strength 💪, speed 🏃, resistance 🛡️, and other special powers. The boosts are temporary but impactful, encouraging smart timing and tactical decisions 🧠🔥.**

Charms are stackable and easy to carry, making them convenient tools for adventurers 🎒 Keep them in your hotbar and activate them the moment the situation demands it.

All charm items are marked with rarity and custom textures, giving them a clean and polished vanilla-friendly feel 🎨✨ They blend smoothly into Minecraft’s existing style while adding something fresh and exciting.

Mo'CharmsMod supports balanced survival progression 🌍 Players must obtain charms through crafting 🔨, trading 🤝, or exploration 🏔️, keeping gameplay fair and rewarding.

Charm items can be traded with piglins 🐷🔥, adding a unique Nether interaction and giving players another exciting way to obtain powerful effects.

Whether you’re battling mobs 👹, exploring dangerous biomes 🌋, or preparing for boss fights 🐉, Mo'CharmsMod puts temporary power in your hands with simple, click-based activation.

‼️ SUPPORT: NEOFORGE ONLY! 🔧🔥
🚧 FABRIC COMING SOON! 🚧****
